title: Review V2 requirements and overall design
goal: Independently review TASK-023 proposed V2 requirements, change package, and overall architecture against the user scenario and governance gates
acceptance_criteria: Review checks every actual TASK-023 change and complete final proposed content
Review verifies scenario fidelity, state precedence, arrival window semantics, migration safety, desktop-only scope, and the overall-to-detailed approval gate

release_controls.execution_window: current approved V2 design review session
release_controls.rollback_plan: remove unrecorded review evidence and reopen TASK-023 if changes are required
release_controls.observation_metrics: structured findings, exact change manifest, content fingerprint, and Release governance results
release_controls.stop_conditions: scope mismatch, unapproved detailed design, active baseline mutation, or incomplete evidence
